allow: Shell(cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null; echo "=== go.mod ==="; cat go.mod; echo "=== .env tracked? ==="; git ls-files | grep -E "\.env|postman" ; echo "=== .env in history? ==="; git log --all --oneline -- .env | head -5; echo "=== migrations ==="; ls migrations/)
Shell(FIBER=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.6; grep -n "func (app \*App) Group" -A 12 $FIBER/app.go | head -20; grep -n "func (grp \*Group) Get" -A 4 $FIBER/group.go)
Shell(go build ./... && echo BUILD_OK; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head -10; python3 -m json.tool ai-smart-storage.postman_collection.json > /dev/null && echo POSTMAN_JSON_OK; go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -22)
